missions.title: Stallholders' Charter
missions.description: Pigbarter trades beneath leaking roofs and disputed toll boards. Build a proper market and enlarge the city so its stallholders can bargain under a common charter.
missions.objective: Pigbarter: 15 development and a marketplace or upgrade.

missions.title: Honest Weights
missions.trigger: 2206 = { trade_share = { country = ROOT share = 25 } }
missions.description: Our charter is worthless if every quay weighs silver differently. Make the River Ruin our home market and establish a quarter share of its trade.
missions.objective: 25% River Ruin trade power.

missions.title: Factors of the Upper Ruin
missions.trigger:
num_of_light_ship = 5
2206 = { trade_share = { country = ROOT share = 35 } }
missions.description: River cargo is bought long before it reaches Pigbarter. Send factors upriver and maintain enough light ships to protect their contracts.
missions.objective: 35% River Ruin trade power and 5 light ships.

missions.title: Customs of the River Ruin
missions.description: Too much of the river trade passes through private toll stations. Bring half its commerce under our factors and make Pigbarter a port worthy of its customs house.
missions.objective: 50% River Ruin trade power; own Pigbarter with a level 3 centre of trade.

missions.title: Courts of Appeal
missions.description: A disputed cargo can provoke a feud that closes the river. Establish courts beside the markets in five provinces so merchants can appeal to a common commercial law.
missions.objective: Own 5 provinces that each have a courthouse or town hall AND a marketplace, trade depot or stock exchange.

missions.title: The Grand River Exchange
missions.description: A single crowded quay cannot handle an imperial volume of business. Upgrade a second exchange on the River Ruin and bring three fifths of its commerce into our network.
missions.objective: 60% River Ruin trade power; own 2 level 2 or level 3 centres of trade.

missions.title: Western Ind Contracts
missions.trigger:
num_of_transport = 10
4103 = { trade_share = { country = ROOT share = 25 } }
missions.description: The River Ruin has made us wealthy enough to seek cargo abroad. Win a share of western Ind and maintain transports to supply our factors.
missions.objective: 25% Western Ind trade power and 10 transports.

missions.title: Eastern Colonies
missions.trigger: 2748 = { trade_share = { country = ROOT share = 25 } }
missions.description: The eastern sea routes are crowded with merchants who have never heard our charter read. Establish overseas holdings and earn a substantial place in their exchanges.
missions.objective: 25% Eastern Colonies trade power.

missions.title: The Imperial River Circuit
missions.trigger:
2206 = { trade_share = { country = ROOT share = 80 } }
2972 = { trade_share = { country = ROOT share = 50 } }
missions.description: Foreign ventures must strengthen the river that sustains the empire. Dominate the River Ruin and secure the Ivory Road traffic that feeds its markets.
missions.objective: 80% River Ruin and 50% Ivory Road trade power.

missions.title: The World's Markets
missions.description: Our bills of exchange now travel farther than most kings. Secure a near monopoly on the River Ruin and build the great exchanges needed to finance world commerce.
missions.objective: 90% River Ruin trade power, 100 monthly income, 3 level 3 centres.

missions.title: Ruinmouth Slipways
missions.description: Mud banks and makeshift jetties leave our hulls rotting between voyages. Build two proper docks to give the river fleet a dependable base.
missions.objective: 3 owned ports with docks or drydocks.

missions.title: Paid to Keep Sailing
missions.trigger:
navy_size_percentage = 0.75
has_leader_with = { admiral = yes total_pips = 6 }
missions.description: A dockyard alone does not persuade sailors to face the Scalded Delta. Put a substantial fleet in commission and hire an admiral who can bring it home.
missions.objective: 75% naval force limit and an admiral with at least 6 total pips.

missions.title: Trading Under Escort
missions.trigger:
num_of_light_ship = 12
navy_tradition = 25
missions.description: Our contracts multiply faster than our captains can protect them. Establish a practiced light-ship escort service along the River Ruin.
missions.objective: 12 light ships and 25 naval tradition.

missions.title: Seaborne Supply
missions.trigger:
num_of_transport = 10
navy_size = 25
missions.description: Guards, provisions and replacement crews must arrive before a stranded factor loses his nerve. Assemble a transport service within a fleet large enough to defend it.
missions.objective: 10 transports and 25 total ships.

missions.title: A Navy Worth Its Charter
missions.trigger:
navy_tradition = 40
has_flagship = yes
num_of_heavy_ship = 5
missions.description: Our fleet can now carry the republic beyond its familiar waters. The council must decide whether its finest ships will lead merchant convoys or impose our terms in battle.
missions.objective: 40 naval tradition, a flagship, and 5 heavy ships; choice event.

missions.title: Imperial Dockyards
missions.description: Our imperial charter promises markets beyond the known sea lanes. Build five shipyards so the council can commission explorers and dispatch permanent colonial expeditions.
missions.objective: 5 coastal shipyards or grand shipyards; grants explorer recruitment and +1 colonist.

missions.title: Soundings Past the Delta
missions.trigger:
num_of_continents = 2
navy_size = 40
missions.description: The imperial yards have given us the means to venture abroad. Establish a holding on another continent and support it with a fleet fit for long voyages.
missions.objective: Holdings on 2 continents and 40 ships.

missions.title: Navigation School
missions.description: Experience is scattered among captains who guard their charts like treasure. Bring proven naval officers or an expert advisor into a permanent school of navigation.
missions.objective: 50 naval tradition and an 8-pip admiral; employ a navigator or naval reformer of at least level 1.

missions.title: Guard Every Convoy
missions.trigger:
navy_size = 100
navy_tradition = 60
missions.description: Our factors now trade beyond the reach of occasional patrols. Maintain a hundred ships and an experienced service capable of guarding every major convoy.
missions.objective: 100 ships and 60 naval tradition.

missions.title: Mistress of the Eastern Seas
missions.trigger:
navy_size_percentage = 1
navy_tradition = 90
missions.description: The counting houses can finance a fleet that no neighbour can ignore. Bring the navy to full strength and make its seamanship the envy of the eastern seas.
missions.objective: 100% naval force limit and 90 naval tradition.

missions.title: Elect the Quay Council
missions.description: Pigbarter has many loud voices and too few decisions that survive the next market day. Earn the guilds a working council, or establish an equally capable civic administration.
missions.objective: Complete a burgher agenda and reach 60 burgher loyalty; without burghers, own Pigbarter at 20 development.

missions.title: Peace in the Stilt Streets
missions.trigger:
stability = 2
OR = { republican_tradition = 90 legitimacy = 90 devotion = 90 }
missions.description: The council cannot settle accounts while every argument becomes a street battle. Restore stable rule and enough public confidence for its judgments to stand.
missions.objective: +2 stability and 90 republican tradition, legitimacy or devotion.

missions.title: A Worthy Republic
missions.trigger:
total_development = 100
stability = 3
missions.description: Our neighbours still remember a muddy market town. Build a larger and more stable commonwealth that its citizens have good reason to defend.
missions.objective: 100 total development and +3 stability.

missions.title: The Company Charter
missions.description: Our companies have grown beyond the customs that once restrained them. Write a charter that either brings their offices into the state or makes their foreign partnerships an instrument of policy.
missions.objective: 2 burgher agendas and 65 loyalty; without burghers, 30 monthly income; choice event.

missions.title: The Common Treasury
missions.trigger:
monthly_income = 40
treasury = 500
missions.description: The companies keep separate purses, but a wider republic needs money it can call its own. Build a steady public income and a common reserve before promising an imperial charter.
missions.objective: Earn at least 40 ducats per month and hold 500 ducats in the treasury.

missions.title: Proclaim the Swinetrade
missions.trigger: num_of_cities = 50
missions.description: The provinces and fleet now deserve a common imperial settlement. Proclaim the Swinetrade Empire through the formation decision and settle whether its charter serves one people or many.
missions.objective: Own 50 cities.

missions.title: Government by Contract
missions.description: An imperial charter cannot be enforced from a single counting house. Extend the provincial court network to ten towns so the government can honour its contracts throughout the realm.
missions.objective: 10 owned provinces with courthouses or town halls.

missions.title: The Charter Made Real
missions.description: Our founding choice cannot remain an elegant inscription. Make the common charter a reality through shared culture and faith, or through the secure acceptance of several peoples.
missions.objective: Unity: 25 primary-culture provinces and 100% religious unity. Diversity: 6 accepted cultures. Alternative: 25 primary-culture provinces, 5 accepted cultures and 100% religious unity.

missions.title: Salaried Magistrates
missions.trigger:
OR = { republican_tradition = 90 legitimacy = 90 devotion = 90 }
prestige = 90
missions.description: Private fees still tempt provincial judges to sell public justice. Retain expert administrators and sufficient republican confidence to place the magistracy on a reliable salary.
missions.objective: 90 prestige and 90 republican tradition, legitimacy or devotion.

missions.title: The Empire That Pays
missions.description: Our neighbours have learned the value of keeping our contracts. Prove that the empire can meet its obligations without debt, factional disorder or a weakened republic.
missions.objective: +3 stability, 90 republican tradition, legitimacy or devotion, and no loans.

missions.title: The Golden Boar Rules
missions.description: Once the world came to Pigbarter to buy livestock and hire guards. Carry the golden boar into the ledgers of fifteen great markets, until our contracts shape the commerce of the world.
missions.objective: Exactly Westerland's ultimate trade test: 51% power in 15 nodes; identical four permanent modifiers.

missions.title: Strange Friends
missions.description: Pigbarter survives because a living market is useful to its neighbours. Enlarge the town and cultivate two dependable allies before a stronger power decides otherwise.
missions.objective: 2 countries with at least 60 trust.

missions.title: Contracts with Vorag
missions.trigger: swine_vorag_settled = yes
missions.description: Vorag commands the dead near routes our merchants cannot afford to ignore. Secure its stronghold and hinterland through conquest or a binding alliance, then decide how its commerce will be handled.
missions.objective: Secure Vorag and 3 provinces of its original hinterland through conquest, a loyal subject, or a substantial alliance; choice event.

missions.title: Bargain with the Chorfs
missions.trigger: swine_zharr_settled = yes
missions.description: The furnaces of Zharr-Naggrund hunger for an outlet down the River Ruin. Settle the question of its power by controlling the city and surrounding plain or binding their ruler to a dependable alliance.
missions.objective: Secure Zharr-Naggrund and 5 provinces of the Plain of Zharr through conquest, a loyal subject, or alliance; choice event.

missions.title: Orcs on the Payroll
missions.trigger: swine_orcs_settled = yes
missions.description: A caravan guard is useful only if he is better paid than the raiders. Bind a substantial Greenskin realm to our interests or secure its Badlands approaches ourselves.
missions.objective: Ally a Greenskin realm holding 5 Badlands provinces, or hold 5 there directly/through loyal subjects.

missions.title: Pay the Ogres' Share
missions.trigger: swine_ogres_settled = yes
missions.description: The Ogre kingdoms regard every caravan as a meal, a toll payment or an employment offer. Secure their mountain routes through a substantial alliance or dependable provincial control.
missions.objective: Ally an Ogre realm holding 5 Mountains of Mourn provinces, or hold 5 there directly/through loyal subjects.

missions.title: The Dragon Isles Settlement
missions.trigger: swine_dragon_isles_settled = yes
missions.description: The Dragon Isles guard sea lanes that imperial captains must learn to use. Secure ten island provinces or a durable alliance with an island power whose rulers can enforce our agreements.
missions.objective: Control 10 Dragon Isles provinces directly/through loyal subjects, or ally a regional ruler holding 10.

missions.title: Treaty Brokers
missions.description: Our regional bargains have made Pigbarter a meeting place for envoys. Build a network of respected allies and a diplomatic service capable of keeping their interests aligned.
missions.objective: 3 countries with at least 90 trust; 3 diplomatic reputation.

missions.title: The Free River Pact
missions.description: The river is safest when its greatest beneficiaries depend on one another. Combine decisive commercial power with three enduring alliances to give free navigation credible protectors.
missions.objective: 80% River Ruin trade power and 4 countries with at least 75 trust.

missions.title: The Darklands Settlement
missions.trigger: swine_darklands_settled = yes
missions.description: The old bargains leave gaps where a new toll lord or raiding host can still close the roads. Bring every province of the Darklands under our rule, loyal subjects or trusted allied rulers, until the whole region has a stake in keeping trade alive.
missions.objective: Every province in the Darklands superregion is owned by us, a subject below 50% liberty desire, or an independent ally with 60 trust and 100 opinion.
missions.highlight:
superregion = darklands_superregion
NOT = { swine_friendly_province = yes }

missions.title: No One Hunts Our Merchants
missions.trigger:
mercantilism = 25
num_of_merchants = 4
missions.description: A merchant carrying our seal should be worth more alive than robbed. Entrench our commercial privileges and sustain four merchant offices so every hostile ruler must reckon with the trade they would lose.
missions.objective: At least 25 mercantilism and 4 merchants.

missions.title: Secure the Ruinmouth
missions.trigger: swine_fimdirach_settled = yes
missions.description: Fimdirach controls the marshes south of Pigbarter and the mouth of the River Ruin. Secure the two key approaches and a lasting foothold in the Scalded Delta, through conquest or an alliance with its masters.
missions.objective: Secure provinces 2147 and 2156 plus 3 Scalded Delta provinces; conquest/loyal subjects or a substantive alliance.

missions.title: Strix Above the Streets
missions.description: An agreement at the river mouth does not keep every raider away from our streets. Give the strix lookouts a trained garrison and professional military direction.
missions.objective: Barracks or training fields in Pigbarter; a military advisor.

missions.title: Granaries of the Delta
missions.description: A crowded port is only one failed convoy away from hunger. Develop a prosperous grain or livestock estate in the delta to secure its provisions.
missions.objective: A prosperous grain/livestock province in Pigbarter or Scalded Delta with a farm estate.

missions.title: The Marshwardens
missions.description: The river settlements need watch posts that can survive more than a sudden raid. Fortify two approaches and repair the devastation around them.
missions.objective: 5 owned provinces with forts of any tier.

missions.title: Provincial Militia
missions.description: A widening frontier cannot depend on a handful of guards from Pigbarter. Organise the provincial levies through local obligations or a professional military office.
missions.objective: 2 noble agendas; without nobles, 20 regiments and a military advisor of at least level 1.

missions.title: The First Peace Dividend
missions.description: Our preparations should leave more than tax demands and empty granaries. Restore prosperity across six provinces and clear the debts of consolidation.
missions.objective: 6 prosperous provinces and no loans.

missions.title: The Harbour Watch
missions.description: Distant commerce attracts enemies who would rather burn a warehouse than negotiate. Build coastal defences in three ports to protect the empire while its fleets are abroad.
missions.objective: 3 ports with coastal defences or naval batteries.

missions.title: Roads Safe for Silver
missions.description: Prosperity follows a road only when caravans can trust its markets and patrols. Develop five commercial towns where disorder and devastation no longer threaten ordinary business.
missions.objective: 5 provinces at 20 development with markets or upgrades, below 1 unrest and devastation.

missions.title: Peace of the Golden Boar
missions.description: The empire must offer its inhabitants something better than a larger collection of tolls. Sustain prosperity across twenty provinces and bring quiet to every market we own on the River Ruin.
missions.objective: 50 prosperous owned provinces.

events.title: The Companies and the Commonwealth
events.desc: The companies that once rented muddy stalls now employ clerks in distant cities. Their charters overlap, their toll exemptions conflict, and every director claims that his privilege is indispensable to the republic. The quay council must decide what these private empires owe the public.\n\nSome delegates would bind the companies into a common provincial administration. Others argue that their foreign correspondents are worth more than another office in Pigbarter.
options: Bring their offices under the charter.
Give their foreign partners a seat at our table.

events.title: The Admiralty of the Golden Boar
events.desc: The captains have assembled beneath a new ensign, arguing over the purpose of the fleet that will carry it. Factors want escorts beside every valuable cargo, while fighting captains demand ships ready to force a passage through hostile waters.\n\nBoth parties know that the River Ruin is our livelihood. The council must choose which duty will shape the admiralty's training, appointments and accounts.
options: The convoys are the life of the republic.
Our contracts will sail behind our guns.

events.title: Accounts That Outlive Their Keepers
events.desc: The settlement around Vorag has opened routes that our merchants once marked with warnings. Its vaults contain goods whose former owners will never dispute a receipt, and its silent roads offer opportunities that respectable factors hesitate to discuss.\n\nThe council can authorise closely supervised commerce through these markets. It can instead spend its influence on protections for living travellers and clear rules for every agent who carries our seal. Both courses will require officials willing to work after sunset.
options: Every cargo will pass through an audited ledger.
Our protection must follow every living traveller.

events.title: The Furnace and the Quayside
events.desc: The settlement with Zharr-Naggrund has changed the arithmetic of the River Ruin. Furnace masters, merchants and dock officials now dispute who will profit from the cargo moving between the great industrial city and our ports.\n\nOur delegates propose two ways to use the agreement. One directs investment into workshops and commercial production; the other reserves its supplies for an expanded fleet. The council must decide which accounts to underwrite.
options: Supply the workshops of the republic.
Reserve the supplies for our dockyards.
